findings.title: Fix mirrors vanilla's own guard; the old line threw outside the try/catch
findings.detail: Pawn_Thinker.ConstantThinkNodeRoot is `ConstantThinkTree.thinkRoot` with no null check, so the previous `?.ConstantThinkNodeRoot` threw a null reference whenever mutant, life stage and race all left the constant tree unset. That throw happened before the postfix's try block, so it escaped the patch and vanilla's error recovery never caught it. The new `ConstantThinkTree?.thinkRoot` is the same check vanilla's DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob makes on its first line. No change needed.

findings.title: Titans whose race lacks a constant think tree still get no ability AI, and nothing says so
findings.detail: Because of `root == null`, the postfix returns early for any titan race without a constant tree, so its abilities never fire from this path and no log line says why. That was already the intent before this diff; the diff only makes it work instead of throwing. This mod never sets thinkTreeConstant, so whether a titan has one depends on its race's base def. A one-time warning on that early return would make the gap visible to def authors. This is my opinion of what would help, not a defect.
